verdict.rationale: ADK is explicitly deployment-agnostic and open-source, supporting manual containerization to run in any environment, offline/disconnected operation with no Google Cloud connection, local model adapters, and self-hosted deployment without vendor lock-in, while Cloud Run/Agent Runtime remain optional managed alternatives rather than requirements. missing for 10: independent third-party confirmation of fully self-hosted production deployments and details on self-managed scaling/observability parity with the managed service.
